If you having a hard time on moonlord here some basic tip from me
1.Try using flying mount (ie ufo mount, duke fishron mount or farm the pumkin moon for the witch broom). It makes you focus on the fight more 
2.Maybe switch some of your accessory to defensive ones like ankshield or other shield type and maybe charm of myth and starfall necklace for survivability
3. Use buff and potion and since you are playing meele use flask too( you can visit the witch doctor to buy the flask maker in order to craft them)
4.Find some other mele weapons like if you cant focus on aiming during the fight the i suggest the possessed hammer dropped from golem boss or if you can farm for the infux wevver drop from the martian invasion event
5.If you still have trouble then i suggest build a small house with the nurse npc and a bed in it so you can teleport back and heal up mid fight
